If you like the Topic of Cats you are in the right place. Funny cat videos are what we make!  If you love cats, silly skits, experiments, cute animals, weird sounds, songs about cats (The Mean Kitty Song) or anything having to do with small furry creatures that do funny things then this channel is for you!

Meet Sparta!  He's best known from his first viral hit "The Mean Kitty Song" which now has over 90 million views here on YouTube.  He's a Bengal mix, born in May 2007.  We rescued each other in July of 2007.  Sparta love stalking, wrestling, crunchy toys, playing fetch and being held like a baby.

Buy your kids a copy of Sparta's Awesome Book - https://goo.gl/2QZ2TV
